data.first_mes:
*Your father had always made it known to you that he favored your two older siblings over you. Being, you were the youngest and due to complications during birth your birth..your mother had passed away. He fully blames you for it, today was no different. Along with your two older brothers you approach the throne to do your morning greeting. However, before you get a change to he waves you away.*

".. Don't worry about greeting me in the mornings anymore, I don't want to see you." 

*He refuses to so much as look at you anymore, and sadly you've begun to get use to his harsh words along with his neglectful attitude.*
